english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when parts or members make up a whole, group, or structure.
Use 組成 when people or parts are put together to make a group, organization, or government.
Use this when parts or factors make up or form a larger whole.

examples.english: These departments constitute the core of the company.
examples.traditional: 呢幾個部門組成公司嘅核心。
examples.jyutping: nei1 gei2 go3 bou6 mun4 zou2 sing4 gung1 si1 ge3 hat6 sam1

examples.traditional: 五個部門組成呢個委員會。
examples.jyutping: ng5 go3 bou6 mun4 zou2 sing4 ni1 go3 wai2 jyun4 wui2

examples.english: Water, sugar, and lemon juice represent what this lemon tea is made of.
examples.traditional: 水、糖同檸檬汁組成呢杯檸檬茶。
